archived.note: Archived fork of Nous Research hermes-agent (MIT); replaced by BLUX; reference only

repositories.owns: Contract v1, the capability registry and policy, Model API v1 and routing, Hook System v1, the runtime, the direct `blux` CLI, the training data pipeline and Gen 0 evaluation harness
repositories.never_owns: Device control, receipt persistence, audits, discovery, repository creation, product business truth
repositories.interface: `blux` CLI (one JSON document per machine command), blux-sdk (Python), contracts/v1 schemas
repositories.integration_boundary: Calls engines as subprocesses (ADR-0009) and providers only through the Model API; emits receipts to BLUX System through its CLI (ADR-0008)

repositories.owns: Execution truth: receipts, operation graph, timelines, artifact references, replay metadata, retention
repositories.interface: `blux-system` CLI (one JSON document per command), Python API
repositories.integration_boundary: Receives receipts from BLUX via its CLI; consumers read through `show/list/graph/timeline`; depends on blux-sdk pinned to a commit

repositories.owns: Provider transport behind Model API v1: retries, streaming, normalization
repositories.never_owns: Agent loops, tool execution, routing across providers, ecosystem authority
repositories.integration_boundary: Invoked only by the BLUX Model API router as a subprocess backend

repositories.owns: Deterministic structured reasoning with replayable artifacts
repositories.interface: `coga` / `blux-coga` CLI, `.blux/` capabilities (reason.analyze, reason.compare, reason.critique, reason.decompose, reason.plan, reason.rank, reason.risk)
repositories.integration_boundary: Standalone engine; BLUX and `ax reason` call it as a subprocess

repositories.owns: Construction, modification and repair changesets with rollback
repositories.interface: `ca` / `blux-ca` CLI, `.blux/` capabilities (artifact.construct, artifact.modify, artifact.repair, artifact.validate, code.patch, repo.patch, config.generate)
repositories.integration_boundary: Standalone engine; called by BLUX and `ax build`; hands validation to DAT

repositories.owns: Independent audit, security, quality and release gates
repositories.interface: `dat` CLI, `.blux/` capabilities (repo.audit, repo.security, repo.quality, repo.release, package.audit, artifact.audit, policy.verify)
repositories.integration_boundary: Standalone; may reject any component's work; called by cA, BLUX and `ax audit`

repositories.owns: Deterministic repository creation, scaffolding and migration
repositories.interface: `lrc` CLI, `.blux/` capabilities (repo.create, repo.scaffold, repo.migrate, repo.compile, repo.validate)
repositories.integration_boundary: Standalone; called by `ax create` and BLUX

repositories.owns: Discovery of projects, capabilities and commands (reads `.blux/` through blux-sdk)
repositories.interface: `god` CLI and `.blux/` capabilities (registry.index, capability.discover, capability.describe, capability.compat, project.describe, command.discover)
repositories.integration_boundary: Read-only; called by `ax projects/capabilities` and BLUX App

repositories.owns: Local mission control: read-only views over the BLUX tools; read-only BLUX System checks as its only controls
repositories.interface: `blux-app serve|snapshot` (127.0.0.1 web UI and JSON API)
repositories.integration_boundary: Calls `blux`, `blux-system`, `god`, `voidforge` executables only

repositories.owns: cA evaluation/training records produced by the pinned cA engine, with splits, locks and canaries
repositories.integration_boundary: Read by the Gen 0 harness and the routing studies; never copied into other repositories

repositories.owns: CogA evaluation/training records produced by the pinned CogA engine, with splits, locks and canaries
repositories.integration_boundary: As the cA dataset

repositories.owns: The developer control plane: routes each command to the authoritative engine (exit 69 when missing); the `axiom` cockpit identity
repositories.never_owns: Reimplementing any engine; the AXIOM Launcher (that is void.os)
repositories.integration_boundary: Routes only; each engine stays the authority

repositories.owns: Environment and toolchain authority (`ax env`) and dotfiles
repositories.integration_boundary: Called by `ax env`

repositories.never_owns: Dotfiles, routing, audits, discovery, devices, intelligence
